LISTING_AGREEMENT.title: Listing agreement
LISTING_AGREEMENT.subtitle: Mandate to market a property for sale or rent

clauses.c1: [PLACEHOLDER — pending lawyer review] The owner instructs the agency to market the property described above on the terms stated.
clauses.c2: [PLACEHOLDER — pending lawyer review] The mandate runs for {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} from the date of signature.
clauses.c3: [PLACEHOLDER — pending lawyer review] The commission stated above is due on completion of a sale or letting to a client introduced by the agency.
clauses.c4: [PLACEHOLDER — pending lawyer review] The owner confirms they are entitled to dispose of the property and will provide the documents the law requires.
clauses.c5: [PLACEHOLDER — pending lawyer review] Personal data is processed by the agency to perform this agreement, as its privacy notice describes.

RESERVATION.title: Reservation agreement
RESERVATION.subtitle: Reservation of a property against a deposit

clauses.c1: [PLACEHOLDER — pending lawyer review] The client reserves the property described above at the agreed price and pays the reservation deposit stated.
clauses.c2: [PLACEHOLDER — pending lawyer review] The property is taken off the market for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} from the date of signature.
clauses.c3: [PLACEHOLDER — pending lawyer review] The deposit is credited against the price on signature of the private purchase contract.
clauses.c4: [PLACEHOLDER — pending lawyer review] The conditions under which the deposit is returned or kept are to be set by the parties' lawyers.
clauses.c5: [PLACEHOLDER — pending lawyer review] Personal data is processed by the agency to perform this agreement, as its privacy notice describes.

VIEWING_SHEET.title: Viewing sheet
VIEWING_SHEET.subtitle: Record of properties shown to a client

clauses.c1: [PLACEHOLDER — pending lawyer review] The client confirms the agency showed them the {count, plural, one {property} other {# properties}} listed above on the date stated.
clauses.c2: [PLACEHOLDER — pending lawyer review] The client agrees to deal with the agency for any purchase or rental of these properties.
clauses.c3: [PLACEHOLDER — pending lawyer review] Personal data is processed by the agency to arrange the viewings, as its privacy notice describes.

OFFER.title: Purchase offer
OFFER.subtitle: Written offer to buy a property

clauses.c1: [PLACEHOLDER — pending lawyer review] The client offers to buy the property described above at the price and on the conditions stated.
clauses.c2: [PLACEHOLDER — pending lawyer review] The offer stands until the date stated and lapses if the owner has not accepted it by then.
clauses.c3: [PLACEHOLDER — pending lawyer review] The agency will pass the offer on to the owner and record the owner's answer.
clauses.c4: [PLACEHOLDER — pending lawyer review] Personal data is processed by the agency to handle the offer, as its privacy notice describes.

COLLABORATION_AGREEMENT.title: Collaboration agreement
COLLABORATION_AGREEMENT.subtitle: Sharing of the commission between two agencies on one transaction

clauses.c1: [PLACEHOLDER — pending lawyer review] The listing agency and the collaborating agency collaborate on the transaction described above.
clauses.c2: [PLACEHOLDER — pending lawyer review] The commission is shared as stated above, from the terms both agencies accepted on the network.
clauses.c3: [PLACEHOLDER — pending lawyer review] Each agency invoices its own share once the commission has been collected.
clauses.c4: [PLACEHOLDER — pending lawyer review] Neither agency contacts the other's client directly without its consent.
clauses.c5: [PLACEHOLDER — pending lawyer review] Disputes are first referred to Inmolink's mediation.

page.title: Sign a document
page.intro: {agency} asks you to sign this document electronically.
page.introNeutral: You are asked to sign this document electronically.
page.codeHint: We e-mail a 6-digit code to {email}. It works for 10 minutes.
page.codeSent: We sent a code to {email}. Check your inbox (and spam folder).
page.name: Your full name
page.typed: Type my name as my signature
page.drawHint: Draw your signature in the box with your finger or mouse.
page.consent: I have read the document above and I agree to sign it electronically. My name, the time, my IP address and my browser are recorded with my signature.
page.signed: Thank you: your signature is recorded. When everyone has signed, we e-mail you the signed document.
page.completed: Everyone has signed. You can download the signed document.
page.waiting: Other people sign before you. We e-mail you when it is your turn.
page.closedTitle: This signing link no longer works
page.closed: The request was withdrawn, replaced by a new one or has expired. Please contact the agency.
page.gone: This link is not valid. Please use the link from your e-mail.
page.limited: Too many requests. Please try again in a few minutes.

errors.badCode: The code is not right. Attempts left for this code: {left}.
errors.codeExpired: This code has expired or was tried too often. Ask for a new code.
errors.wait: We sent a code less than a minute ago. Please wait before asking again.
errors.codeLimit: Too many codes were sent today. Please try again tomorrow or contact the agency.
errors.locked: Too many wrong codes today. Please try again tomorrow or contact the agency.
errors.drawingMissing: Draw your signature in the box (or choose to type your name).
errors.consentMissing: Tick the box to agree to sign electronically.
errors.changed: The document changed since this page was loaded. Reload the page and check it again.
errors.turnstile: Please complete the security check and try again.
errors.unavailable: Signing is not available right now. Please try again later.

email.inviteBody: Hello {name}, {agency} asks you to sign “{document}” electronically. Open the link to read the document and sign it with a code we e-mail you. The link works until {expires}.
email.codeBody: Your code to sign “{document}” is {code}. It works for 10 minutes. If you did not ask for it, ignore this e-mail.
email.completedBody: Everyone has signed “{document}”. The signed document (with its audit trail) is ready. Its SHA-256 fingerprint is {hash}.
email.requesterBody: Everyone has signed “{document}”. The signed document is in the forms library. Its SHA-256 fingerprint is {hash}.

audit.title: Electronic signature audit trail
audit.intro: This page is part of the signed document. It records who signed the document above, when and how.
audit.simple: Simple electronic signature (eIDAS art. 3(10)), e-mail one-time code
audit.note: Times are in UTC. The SHA-256 of this signed file is recorded with the signing request and sent to every signer; any change to the file changes it.
